from pathlib import Path
import json,os
rows=[]
for disk in sorted(Path('/sys/block').iterdir()):
 if not disk.name.startswith('sd'):continue
 targets=[disk]+[p for p in disk.iterdir() if p.name.startswith(disk.name) and (p/'dev').exists()]
 for p in targets:
  rows.append(dict(name=p.name,dev=(p/'dev').read_text().strip(),sectors=int((p/'size').read_text()),holders=sorted(q.name for q in (p/'holders').iterdir()) if (p/'holders').exists() else []))
mounts=[]
for line in Path('/proc/self/mountinfo').read_text().splitlines():
 f=line.split()
 if any(r['dev']==f[2] for r in rows):mounts.append(dict(device=f[2],mountpoint=f[4],filesystem=f[f.index('-')+1]))
x=os.stat('/home/tanh/sponge-sim').st_dev
print(json.dumps(dict(block_devices_and_partitions=rows,matching_mounts=mounts,workspace_device=f'{os.major(x)}:{os.minor(x)}',scope='Read-only block/partition/holder metadata; no mount/eject/media access')))
